parsing_traps.detail: Pages 100-102 show both RMB'000 and S$'000 columns side-by-side. market_valuation captured in SGD (consolidated reporting currency), with RMB amounts preserved as _rmb_valuation_000 audit fields. The two are NOT additive - they are the same valuation in two currencies. Closing rate: ~RMB 5.466/S$.

parsing_traps.trap: Gross revenue / NPI figures are 100% basis in financial review but effective-interest in top-tenants footnote
parsing_traps.detail: Gross Revenue Note (page 26) and NPI Note (page 27) are on 100% stake basis (per footnote i). The top-10 tenants table % uses CLCT's effective interest (51%/80% applied to sub-owned properties). Segment note (page 153) consolidates at group level including NCI.

parsing_traps.trap: Portfolio Statement valuation vs balance sheet investment property
parsing_traps.detail: Portfolio Statement (pages 100-102) total S$4,204,374k matches Note 4 balance sheet investment properties S$4,204,374k - confirmed.
